summary_en: Madhavi, a working professional, enquired about Python, SQL, and PowerBI courses, preferring evening or weekend timings. The agent provided Python with Data Analytics details: 8 weeks, ₹8,999 total, weekday classes from 8:00–9:00 PM or weekend classes on Saturday and Sunday from 10:00 AM–1:00 PM, with no instalment discounts. SQL and PowerBI availability, fees, duration, instalment options, and start dates were not available during the call. The agent explained that Python includes 100% placement assistance through resume building, interview preparation, and job referrals, but no strict job or salary guarantee. Madhavi asked to save her enquiry and arrange a demo or discussion; the agent initially stated that no details had yet been noted, then confirmed that the enquiry was saved. A demo was scheduled for tomorrow at 11:00 AM. Eligibility was explained as any graduate or final-year student with basic computer knowledge; prior coding is not required. The caller confirmed that the information was clear and thanked the agent. The call ended with the agent stating that the details and request to call again had been recorded.
